units: <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 2:9">Tosef. Dem. II, 9</cite> <he>חזרו … במ׳</he> (Var. <he>במטמונות</he>, <he>במטמורנית</he>, corr. acc.) if they repent in secret, opp. <he>בפרהסיא</he>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 7a:11">Ab. Zar. 7ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 31a:1">Bekh. 31ᵃ</cite>.—Lam. R., introd. (R. Josh. 1) <he>היו עובדין אותן במ׳</he> (some ed. <he>במטמניות</he>) they worshipped idols in secret; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 348:1">Yalk. Ez. 348</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:5">Gen. R. s. 52</cite> <he>הולך במ׳</he> he goes to her in secret; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52:5">ib.</cite> s. 74 (v. <cite ref="M01020">preced.</cite>). Ib. s. 17 <he>למה במ׳</he> why did he do it secretly (while Adam was asleep)?—

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 8:1">Pesik. R. s. 8</cite> whatever a man does <he>במ׳ בחשך וכ׳</he> in secret, in the dark or openly; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 959:33">Yalk. Prov. 959</cite>. Pesik. R. l. c. <he>שבמַטְמֹנִיּוֹת</he> whatever is hidden in the secret chambers (of the heart); a. e.
